title: Design: Two ticked rows in bulk mode look as in the design
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have two active parts, part A and part B.
  • Give part A a description long enough to be cut off with "..." in the Description column, so hovering it can show the full text.
  • Give parts A and B part numbers that start with the same text, so one search lists both.
  • Make sure no Cycle count is running on the Inventory list.
  • Make sure the app is in the Light theme.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1600 pixels wide with the page zoom at 100%, so the screen is as wide as the design boards.
  • Open the attached design picture of board 4.3 at 100% zoom, so you can compare the screen with it.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Type the shared start of the part numbers in the Search box.
  2. Click the three-dot actions button (⋮) in the toolbar, to the left of New Inventory Part.
  3. Click Deactivate parts.
  4. Click the part A row.
  5. Click the part B row.
  6. Hover over part A's description.
  7. Click the X at the right end of the dark bar.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Parts A and B are listed.

Step 2:

  • The menu opens.

Step 3:

  • The dark bar shows a round badge with 0.

Step 4:

  • Part A's box is filled dark grey with a white tick, and the whole part A row is shaded light grey.
  • The header box shows a white dash on dark grey: some rows are ticked.
  • The badge reads 1 and the Deactivate button is bright blue.

Step 5:

  • Part B's box and row look the same as part A's.
  • The badge reads 2.
  • Small dark text under the table, at its left, reads "2 records selected."

Step 6:

  • A dark grey tooltip with part A's full description appears just under the part A row.

Step 7:

  • The dark bar, the checkboxes, the shading and the "2 records selected." line disappear.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10815 (Story 2, Deactivate Parts in Bulk)

  • S2-R5: “While the mode is on, a click anywhere on a row ticks or unticks that row instead of opening the part.”
  • S2-R7b: “From left to right the bar shows: the number of ticked rows in a round badge followed by the word "selected", a thin divider, and a blue button reading "Deactivate". The number updates as the user ticks.”

From: Tech plan "Parts Lifecycle Update — Technical Implementation Plan" (7 Oct 2026, written against PRD v22; re-shared by the QA lead on 27 Oct 2026, unchanged), read 27 Oct 2026

  • Tech plan, §3 Technical Decisions, D24: “Show "N records selected." under the table in bulk mode (boards 4.3, 4.9).”
